decision.reasoning_trace: I evaluated the product feed specifically for versatile backpacks suitable for general use or hiking. The consideration set included two tactical-style backpacks, two popular sling bags, and one camo day pack. I narrowed my choice down to the G4Free Tactical Shoulder Backpack (prod_backpacks_050) because it offers a significant capacity (35L) at a very affordable price point ($28.99), backed by a strong 4.6 rating across over 1,800 reviews. Although the TUDEQU sling was highly rated, the G4Free backpack provides more utility for the cost.
